headline: DNA修復の複合体に、Pol λはBRCTとN末端で取り付く
subhead: Pol λとPNKPは同じ複合体の中で協力して、切れた末端を整える
target_label: NHEJ短距離複合体＋Pol λ（ヒト）

summary.question: 切れたDNAの末端は、そのままではつなげないことがある。末端を整える酵素が修復の中核複合体にどう組み込まれるかは不明だった。
summary.approach: 修復の中核複合体にPol λが結合した状態をクライオ電顕で解析し、Pol λとPNKPの働きを試験管内で調べた。
summary.result: 2つのPol λがBRCTドメインでKu70/80に結合し、N末端はXRCC4–LigIVの近くにあった。Pol λとPNKPは同じ複合体の中で末端を処理した。
summary.learned: 中核の複合体は安定した足場になり、酵素が出入りして末端を整える。末端処理は切れ目を保持している間に繰り返し起こる、というモデルを示した。
summary.open: ほかの末端処理酵素にも同じ協調が当てはまるかは、今後の研究課題。

question.quote: NHEJ is capable of repairing a variety of damaged DNA, employing various accessory end-processing factors to resolve chemically blocked ends, trim overhangs, and fill gaps in order to achieve directly ligatable DNA ends.

Single-molecule studies in Xenopus egg extracts indicate that at least certain end-processing events occur during short-range synapsis19, but the molecular details underlying these processes’ coordination with the core NHEJ machinery remain unclear, particularly in terms of the structural accommodation of the accessory factors within the large protein-DNA complexes that mediate repair.

approach.quote: To investigate the molecular mechanisms underlying end-processing, we determine the cryo-EM structure of the NHEJ specific polymerase Pol λ bound to the short-range synaptic complex, detailing the mode of its recruitment to the complex as well as a putative model for its activity.
We also examine the activity of in vitro reconstituted complexes to show that both Pol λ and PNKP can cooperatively process the same DNA substrate within a single protein complex.

result.quote: We observe two copies of Pol λ’s BRCT domain bound to the bridge region of Ku70/80
This revealed a total of 17 crosslinks between the N-terminus of Pol λ and X4L4

Furthermore, the coordinated end-processing activities of the short-range (SR) synaptic complex simultaneously bound by both Pol λ and PNKP, another accessory factor, demonstrates the ability of NHEJ to form large, multifunctional repair complexes capable of processing a variety of different DNA end structures to effect repair.Subject terms: Cryoelectron microscopy, DNA

learned.quote: Our results provide evidence for a model in which NHEJ end-processing occurs iteratively during short-range synapsis, with the core NHEJ factors forming a stable platform for the enzymes to flexibly access the DSB junction.

open.quote: Future studies investigating the activities of other end-processing factors will be needed to determine if this mechanism of coordination is conserved and to test if the formation of even larger complexes capable of repairing a wider variety of DSBs is feasible.

highlights.text: Pol λのBRCTドメインはKu70/80のブリッジをまたいで結合し、N末端のペプチド（残基8–15と推定）がLigIVのC-BRCT1に接する。BS3架橋MSでN末端とXRCC4・LigIVの間に多数の架橋が見つかり、この係留が裏づけられた。全体分解能は7.23 Åで、局所精密化で3.86–4.58 Åである。

evidence.quote: We observe two copies of Pol λ’s BRCT domain bound to the bridge region of Ku70/80
This revealed a total of 17 crosslinks between the N-terminus of Pol λ and X4L4

highlights.text: 末端が相補的でない基質では、LigIVは開いた配座でDSBに留まる。Pol λの触媒ドメインが入る際はLigIVのOBDとNTDが退き、DBDは残って複合体を安定化するというモデルを示す。触媒ドメイン結合状態そのものは電顕で捉えられていない。

evidence.quote: These results support a mechanism whereby the OBD and NTD domains of LigIV’s catalytic domain are displaced by the polymerase during gap filling, while the LigIV DBD maintains its position at the DSB
we did not capture a population of particles by electron microscopy substantial enough to produce a 3D reconstruction with the polymerase’s catalytic domain bound to the DSB

highlights.text: 複合体をMg²⁺なしの緩衝液で組み立て、ビオチン化DNAでプルダウンして未結合因子を除いてからMg²⁺を加える。均質な複合体で酵素活性を測れ、同じ試料を電顕にも回せる。Pol λ、PNKP、LigIVが共存して初めて両鎖が連結される基質も示した。

evidence.quote: The assembly of the complex and its enzymatic activities are separated by first adding components in a buffer free of Mg2+ followed by performing a pulldown on the biotinylated nucleic acid substrate
This SR-Pol λ-PNKP complex processes and ligates substrates containing both overhangs and chemically blocked ends, with double ligation only occurring in the presence of both end-processing factors

lab_notes.expression: Pol λは大腸菌Rosetta2(DE3)でGST融合として発現（18°C、IPTG 0.4 mM）。Ku70/80とLigIV-XRCC4はSf9、XLF・PAXX・PNKPは大腸菌。
lab_notes.construct: ヒトPol λ全長（Met1–Trp575）、N末端GST融合。
lab_notes.purification: グルタチオンSepharoseでTEV切断 → Superdex 200。
lab_notes.sample_prep: 1 nt非相補3′突出DNAで複合体を組み立て、GraFix（10–30%グリセロール/グルタルアルデヒド）で安定化。グラフェンオキサイド grid、Vitrobot IV。
lab_notes.data_collection: Titan Krios＋K3、14,845ムービー、総線量62 e⁻/Å²。cryoSPARC 4.6で処理し、全体7.23 Å。

evidence.quote: The sequence encoding full-length human Pol λ (Met1-Trp575) was cloned into the NotI/EcoRI restriction sites of the pGEXM vector67 to generate an N-terminal GST-tagged fusion protein.
GraFix22 was used to capture the SR-Pol λ complex.
Homemade graphene oxide (GO) grids70 were made for cryo-EM by applying GO to glow-discharged 2/1, 400 mesh Quantifoil grids
Non-uniform refinement of a final set of 179,057 particles yielded a nominal global resolution of 7.23 Å.

editor_notes: 全体分解能が7.23 Åと低く、PDB 9OX8 の詳細な側鎖モデルは局所精密化の範囲に限られる。BRCT・N末端ペプチドの位置はAlphaFold3予測を併用して配置している。『初』とは書いていない。
